about.title: Wasco Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Wasco residents rely on all sorts of consumer, agricultural, and industrial products every day, from equipment used along Rt 46 and Rt 43 corridors to household goods purchased right in town. When a product fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can upend a family's routine fast. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a strict liability claim without having to prove the manufacturer was careless — the defect and the harm it caused are typically what matter most. We handle product liability cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless we recover something for you. If a defective product hurt you in Wasco, it costs nothing to have a conversation about your options.

items.title: Strict Liability Focus
items.desc: California generally lets injured people pursue a claim by showing a product was defective and caused harm, without proving the maker was negligent. We can help identify whether that path applies to your situation.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Be Responsible
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially share liability for a defective product. Our team can help sort out who was involved in getting that product into your hands.

items.title: Guidance on Preserving Evidence
items.desc: Keeping the product itself, along with packaging and receipts, can matter for a strict liability claim. We can advise you early on how to protect that evidence.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability approach generally focuses on whether the product itself was defective and whether that defect caused your injury, rather than requiring proof of carelessness. We can review your situation and explain how this might apply to your claim.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep the product exactly as it was after the incident, along with any packaging, manuals, or receipts. This evidence can be important for a claim, and we can advise you on safe storage and next steps.

items.question: Is this only for accidents on busy roads like Rt 46 or Rt 43?
items.answer: No, product liability claims can arise anywhere in Wasco, whether the injury happened at home, at work, or out and about. It doesn't matter if the incident occurred near a high-traffic corridor or somewhere quiet in the community.

items.question: Do you charge anything for a case review?
items.answer: No, our case review is completely free. We generally work on contingency, meaning we only get paid if we recover compensation for you.
